ui.safety_disclaimer: Always follow Central Insecticides Board (CIBRC) approved safety guidelines before spraying.
ui.community_contribute_hint: Notice an error or want to improve this translation? Click here to contribute.

ppe_requirements.gloves: Wear nitrile chemical-resistant gloves during mixing and spraying.
ppe_requirements.mask: Wear certified N95 or particulate respirator mask to prevent inhalation.
ppe_requirements.eye_protection: Wear protective eye goggles to avoid splashes.
ppe_requirements.boots: Wear rubber gumboots; do not spray barefoot or in sandals.
ppe_requirements.clothing: Wear long-sleeved shirt and full-length trousers.

dosage_and_mixing.dosage_instruction: Mix exactly {dose_amount} per {water_volume} of clean water.
dosage_and_mixing.acreage_guideline: Recommended spray volume is {spray_volume} per acre.
dosage_and_mixing.tank_calibration: Calibrate knapsack sprayer nozzle before use to ensure uniform spray pattern.
dosage_and_mixing.no_overdose_warning: CRITICAL: Do not exceed recommended dosage. Overdosing causes crop phytotoxicity and chemical resistance.

application_timing.weather_conditions: Do not spray during strong winds (>15 km/h) or immediately before rainfall.
application_timing.spray_hours: Apply during early morning (6:00 AM - 9:00 AM) or late afternoon (4:30 PM - 6:30 PM) to protect pollinator bees.
application_timing.pre_harvest_interval: Waiting Period (Pre-Harvest Interval): Do not harvest crops for at least {phi_days} days after application.

emergency_and_first_aid.skin_contact: In case of skin contact, immediately wash affected area with plenty of clean water and soap for at least 15 minutes.
emergency_and_first_aid.eye_contact: In case of eye splash, rinse eyes gently with clean running water for 15 minutes holding eyelids open. Seek medical attention.
emergency_and_first_aid.inhalation: If vapors are inhaled, immediately move patient to fresh air. Loosen tight collar and belts.
emergency_and_first_aid.swallowing_warning: If swallowed, do NOT induce vomiting unless instructed by a qualified medical doctor.
emergency_and_first_aid.antidote_atropine: Administer Atropine sulphate (2 to 4 mg intravenously) under qualified medical supervision until atropinization symptoms appear.
emergency_and_first_aid.antidote_none: No specific antidote known. Treat symptomatically and supportively.

storage_and_disposal.storage_condition: Store in original sealed container in a locked room away from food, animal feed, and children.
storage_and_disposal.empty_container_disposal: Triple rinse empty container, puncture bottom to prevent reuse, and bury safely away from water bodies.
